Name: Lunar Cove by Huskyn1nja
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Welcome to [b]Lunar Cove[/b] a uniquely shaped farm with plenty of room for activities. This farm does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable on its own when creating a new save.

[size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]

• Farm added through AdditionalFarms: Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.
• Dig on grass tiles: Almost everywhere is tillable. Go crazy with your planting
• Custom fish/crab pot Setup: Fish for river fish in the waterfall river, or ocean fish off the beach
• Forest forage and respawning hardwood stumps, logs, and boulders
• Optimized for 4, but supports up to 8-person multiplayer


[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY

[/b][/size]Currently [u]compatible[/u] with SDV expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, RSV, etc.
Mostly [u]compatible[/u] with exterior recolors
